summary: Epitaxial NiO (1 0 0) and NiO (111) films were grown by atomic layer deposition on MgO (1 0 0) and a-Al2O3 (0 0 l) substrates at temperatures as low as 200 1C using bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato)Ni(II) and water as precursors. The films showed epitaxial growth with different orientations on the substrates, and the study aimed to design a low-temperature epitaxial growth process for NiO and establish process/materials characteristics relationships.
evidence: Epitaxial NiO (111) and NiO (1 0 0) films have been grown by atomic layer deposition on both MgO (1 0 0) and a-Al2O3 (0 0 l) substrates at temperatures as low as 200 1C by using bis(2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato)Ni(II) and water as precursors.
